name: VideoCardz: NVIDIA launches GeForce RTX 4090D (NVIDIA China spec table)
notes: Launch write-up reproducing the NVIDIA China spec table for the China-only GeForce RTX 4090D (AD102-250): 14592 CUDA cores, 24 GB GDDR6X at 21 Gbps on a 384-bit bus (1008 GB/s), 425 W TGP, boost 2520 MHz, no factory OC. Not an NVIDIA-hosted document; the numbers are the table VideoCardz attributes to NVIDIA China.
